name: Major Lewis
summary: The pilot at the controls in VN-0016, photographed by Larry in flight aboard the helicopter with call sign Rosethorn 007. Larry flew marathon days aboard this aircraft — once 4 a.m. to 11 p.m., refueling at Qui Nhơn — and identifies the smiling, mustached pilot behind the visor as Major Lewis.
larrysRecollection: This is major Lewis. We are flying in Aircraft Rosethorn 007. (VN-0016 Memories comment, 2026-08-15)
researchNotes: A field-grade aviation officer is comparatively findable once the unit is settled — majors appear in unit histories and flight-operations records. Identity notes and open questions: research/people/major-lewis.md.
